blocks.prompt: 10. The paths of two rays from a star are represented by the equation \(2x^{2} + 5xy - 3y^{2} = 0\). Find the equations of the two lines and determine the angle between the rays.
blocks.explanation:
Sitare se nikalne wali do shuaain (rays) ek hi point se shuru hoti hain, is liye yeh origin se guzarne wali do lines ka jora hai.
Diya kya hai? Joint equation. Find kya karna hai? Dono lines aur un ke darmiyan angle.
Rule: lines ke liye middle term split, angle ke liye \(\tan\theta = \dfrac{2\sqrt{h^{2}-ab}}{a + b}\).
Khaas baat: yahan \(a + b\) negative hai, is liye \(\tan\theta\) negative aayega; ghabrana nahi, us ka matlab samjhenge.
Plan: split, factor, lines, \(a\), \(h\), \(b\), angle, aur aakhir mein slopes se tasdeeq.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(2x^{2} + 5xy - 3y^{2} = 0\).
Maloom karna: dono lines aur shuaon ke darmiyan angle.
Tareeqa: zero-product factorization se lines, aur Section 5.9 ke formula (iv) se angle.

Factorize karein
\[2x^{2} + 6xy - xy - 3y^{2} = 0\]
\[2x(x + 3y) - y(x + 3y) = 0\]
\[(2x - y)(x + 3y) = 0\]
Kyun: aise numbers chahiye jin ka product \(2 \times (-3) = -6\) aur jama 5 ho; woh 6 aur \(-1\) hain. Phir jore bana kar common bracket \((x + 3y)\) nikala.

Dono lines
\[2x - y = 0 \quad \text{aur} \quad x + 3y = 0\]
Kyun: har factor ko zero rakha; har factor ek shua ki line hai.

\(a\), \(h\), \(b\) parhein
\[a = 2,\quad h = \dfrac{5}{2},\quad b = -3\]
\[h^{2} - ab = \dfrac{25}{4} + 6 = \dfrac{49}{4}\]
\[\sqrt{h^{2} - ab} = \dfrac{7}{2}\]
Kyun: \(h\) 5 ka aadha; aur \(-ab = -(2)(-3) = +6\). \(49/4\) perfect square hai, root \(7/2\).
Dhyan dein: \(b = -3\) ka minus sign na giraiye, warna \(h^{2} - ab\) ghalat aayega.

Angle
\[\tan\theta = \dfrac{2(7/2)}{2 + (-3)} = \dfrac{7}{-1} = -7\]
\[\theta = 180^{\circ} - \tan^{-1}7 = 98.13^{\circ}\]
\[\text{acute angle} = 180^{\circ} - 98.13^{\circ} = 81.87^{\circ}\]
Kyun: \(\tan\theta\) negative ka matlab angle obtuse (90 se bada) hai. Do kat-ti lines ke do angle hote hain jin ka jama \(180^{\circ}\) hai, jaise kainchi ke phal. Is liye acute angle \(81.87^{\circ}\) hai; answer key bhi yahi deti hai.

Tasdeeq:
\[m_{1} = 2,\quad m_{2} = -\dfrac{1}{3}\]
\[\left|\dfrac{2 - (-1/3)}{1 + 2(-1/3)}\right| = \dfrac{7/3}{1/3} = 7 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: alag alag slopes se acute angle ka \(\tan\theta = 7\) aaya, aur \(\tan^{-1}7 = 81.87^{\circ}\). Dono raaston se ek hi jawab.
blocks.final_answer: Lines: \(2x - y = 0\) aur \(x + 3y = 0\); shuaon ke darmiyan angle \(81.87^{\circ}\) (acute), ya \(98.13^{\circ}\) (obtuse)

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Answer key ki numbering yahan bhi khiski hui hai: is sawal ka jawab number 11 par ('\(2x - y = 0\), \(x + 3y = 0\), \(81.87^{\circ}\)') chhapa hai, jo sahi hai. Number 10 wala jawab Sawal 9 ka hai.
